reviews.text:
This was our first self wash. The young man was helpful, facility clean and had a wonderful variety of products. It turned out to be a really fun experience for all of us.
We will definitely be retirn customers. Good parking is also a plus.

We’ve been here several times and really appreciate the self-bathing stations. Everything is always clean, well-stocked, and reasonably priced, which makes bath time for my two Golden Retrievers so much easier. I also love that they have fresh dog treats available, and the staff has always been friendly whenever we visit. Overall, it’s a great store for pet supplies and grooming needs. Definitely worth a visit!
Great prices and friendly staff. Love shopping local!

Super friendly staff! They have a crazy array of products and a full dog wash station. I have a hermit crab and they stocked product for me from a really sweet small business. They have stuff for rabbits, reptiles, hermit crabs, dogs, cats, hamsters and probably more. Love this spot!
Friendly staff and wide variety of treats and toys

Incredibly kind staff and very considerate. The owners will buy any pet supplies you need and you can even have things ordered monthly or as needed. They take feedback on what items to stock and they made an effort to stock our unique cat food.
Wonderful customer service experience. Nice product selection and reasonable prices.
Five stars?! Thanks for the love—your support means the world to us!
I come here every Monday for a bath and always end up getting treats or wet food, cookies or kibble. They've got lots of options and a helpful staff! Check em out

Not happy at all! I purchased a large bag of dog food for my puppy however I got the wrong breed. I tried to get a refund cause the store does not carry nutrition source puppy food for small breeds. I was denied a refund cause I did not have the physical receipt on me however the transaction is on my Apple Pay. I showed the young lady the transaction history, the bag of food was never opened or damaged, the purchase was made only 7 days prior. Still no refund or exchange. I am not happy. I will not be returning
The owners are very kind and helpful. Great place my dog loved the ice cream!
Cutest pet store! Stopped in today for a harness & new toy & the selection was great! Absolutely love it!
Good service & good selection!

Our puppy Milly loves to stop in and pick out her favorite treat of the week! Very friendly staff! Clean store with more options than you could imagine ! They have bones and duck feet treats, clothing, toys, treats, food and more! Furville is  very accommodating and can get specific things if want on top of this.. Milly made me right this, it’s not promotional lol!
But they are accommodating and want what’s best for your dog (or cat) if you’re trying out a new food for your pet, they will offer to let you return a new food if it does not work out.
Fully stocked dog wash is another amenity you should take advantage of!
Stop in & check it out for yourself, you won’t leave empty handed!

Our favorite pet store in the area ☺️ They do such a great job maximizing the space they have - I’m always amazed by their selection! And the owners are always so kind. Can’t recommend them enough!! And neither can this guy!! hehe

There’s much more diversity in products than what the google pictures show, the workers are so kind and knowledgeable about the products they sell, and my pup loves the marrow bones! Only downside is parking, but that’s Manayunk.

Such a convenient store…it’s more convenient than the actual convenient store across the street… this one is just for pets tho obvi haha
They have TONS of food options and treat/toys. They don’t favor dogs over cats as far as supply goes (most pet stores I’ve been to cater mostly to dogs).
And their hours are amazing.  Their prices super normal not overpriced at all like lots of local/small shops can be
And everyone that works there has been so incredible nice and helpful.
Really cute store

Awesome place for bathing your dog! I was given a quick tutorial on how to use the tubs. All supplies are provided-- including towels and a dryer. The store is also well stocked so I was able to pick up a few items.
Thank you for the awesome review. 🤍 …

Such a great addition to the neighborhood. The owners are very friendly & helpful. Great set up for self-bathing dogs which made the process seamless. They have everything you could need including dog shampoo, scrubbers, towels & dryers.
Amazing shop with great selection of products to suit all your fur baby's needs!! Must visit place to get all the supplies you need 💯 …

I had to take my dog here last minute for a wash because the place that I usually take him had a power outage and they recommended this place.  The gentleman was so pleasant and they had lots of shampoo, dryers, towels and scrub brushes.

Brought my 60 lb dog for their Monday special (buy a bag of treats, get a free bath). They have plenty of shampoos, conditioners, brushes and spray to use for your dog. They have blow dryers and microfiber towels. Such a wonderful spot to add to the neighborhood!
Great pet shop! We walked past with our dogs and stopped in, they are super friendly with great products. Well priced as well. Our dog picked out a toy and pig ear so it has been doodle approved!
Friendly staff, has Dr. Elsey‘s litter

New pet store just opened. Went in to check it out. Staff was very friendly and helpful. They have a good variety of items currently. They did say they are bringing in more things. They also ask for what your pets like and they might bring in in the future. Nice addition to the area.
